newsitem.title: USA: NYNEX says service improved in Q2.
newsitem.headline: NYNEX says service improved in Q2.

text.p: NYNEX Corp today said Monday it posted improved second quarter service results as reported to the New York State Public Service Commission.

NYNEX said the number of customers reporting a trouble was reduced by 23 percent from the same period a year ago. Missed repair appointments were reduced by 29 percent, reports of customers out of service for more than a day were reduced by 35 percent, and complaints to the Public Service Commission were reduced by more than 51 percent.
The company also said 98 percent of its statewide objectives are being met or exceeded.
NYNEX said it committed last year an additional $1 billion over five years to hiring and investment programs to improve service results.
The company said it added more than 3,500 service-related positions, and accelerated maintenance programs to address potential problems before customers were affected.
The PSC is expected to review NYNEX's second-quarter service results at an upcoming public meeting.
In addition, NYNEX said its proposed merger with Bell Atlantic Corp has received all necessary state approvals and is awaiting final review from the FCC.
